飞机起飞和降落的场所

phrases.usage: 表示过去习惯性的动作或状态，现在已不再如此

examples.en: I used to travel by air a great deal when I was a boy.
examples.zh: 我小时候经常乘飞机旅行。

examples.en: My parents used to live in South America.
examples.zh: 我父母过去住在南美洲。

examples.en: A flight attendant would take charge of me.
I am used to travelling by air.
Only on one occasion have I ever felt frightened.
examples.zh: 我只曾在一次感到害怕。

examples.en: The plane was slowly gaining height.
The plane suddenly turned round and flew back to the airport.
examples.zh: 飞机突然掉头飞回机场。

examples.en: A flight attendant told us to keep calm.
examples.zh: 乘务员告诉我们保持冷静。

examples.en: Get off the plane quietly as soon as it had touched down.
examples.zh: 飞机一着陆就安静地下飞机。
飞机上的每个人都很担心。

examples.en: We were curious to find out what had happened.
examples.zh: 我们好奇想知道发生了什么事。

grammar.title: used to 的用法
grammar.structure: 主语 + used to + 动词原形
grammar.definition: used to表示过去经常发生的动作或存在的状态，而现在不再如此 用于描述过去的习惯、状态，与现在形成对比

examples.en: I used to travel by air a great deal.
examples.zh: 我过去经常乘飞机旅行。

examples.en: My parents used to live in South America.
examples.zh: 我父母过去住在南美洲。

grammar.title: 过去进行时 + when + 一般过去时
grammar.structure: 过去进行时 + when + 一般过去时
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻正在进行的动作被另一突然发生的动作打断 when引导的短句通常表示突发情况，when可理解为'就在这时'

examples.en: We were flying low over the city when the plane suddenly turned round.
examples.zh: 我们正在城市上空低飞，这时飞机突然掉头。

examples.en: I was reading a book when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 我正在看书，突然电话响了。

grammar.title: 过去完成时
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作 用于描述过去的过去，常与after、before、when等连用，或用于宾语从句中

examples.en: The police had been told that a bomb had been planted.
examples.zh: 警察已被告知飞机上被安置了一颗炸弹。

examples.en: After we had landed, the plane was searched.
examples.zh: 我们降落之后，飞机被彻底搜查。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + used to + 动词原形

original.en: I used to travel by air a great deal.
original.zh: 我过去经常乘飞机旅行。

imitations.en: She used to live in Paris.
He used to smoke, but now he doesn't.
imitations.zh: 他过去抽烟，但现在不抽了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be used to + doing sth

original.en: I am used to travelling by air.

imitations.en: She is used to getting up early.
They are used to living in a big city.

patterns.pattern: 过去进行时 + when + 一般过去时

original.en: We were flying low over the city and slowly gaining height, when the plane suddenly turned round.
original.zh: 我们正在城市上空低飞并缓慢爬升，突然飞机掉头了。

imitations.en: I was walking home when it started to rain.
imitations.zh: 我正走回家，突然开始下雨了。

imitations.en: She was cooking dinner when the doorbell rang.
imitations.zh: 她正在做晚饭，突然门铃响了。

original.en: After we had landed, the plane was searched thoroughly.
original.zh: 我们降落之后，飞机被彻底搜查。

imitations.en: After I had finished my homework, I watched TV.
imitations.zh: 我完成作业之后看了电视。

imitations.en: After he had left, we started to clean the room.
imitations.zh: 他离开之后，我们开始打扫房间。

lines.en: I used to travel by air a great deal when I was a boy.
lines.zh: 我在幼年的时候，曾多次乘飞机旅行。

lines.en: My parents used to live in South America and I used to fly there from Europe in the holidays.
lines.zh: 我的父母曾经住在南美洲，所以假期里我常从欧洲乘飞机到他们那里。

lines.en: A flight attendant would take charge of me and I never had an unpleasant experience.
lines.zh: 我总是由一位空中乘务员照管，从未遇到过不愉快的经历。

lines.en: I am used to travelling by air and only on one occasion have I ever felt frightened.
lines.zh: 我习惯了乘飞机旅行，只是有一次把我吓坏了。

lines.en: After taking off, we were flying low over the city and slowly gaining height, when the plane suddenly turned round and flew back to the airport.
lines.zh: 起飞之后，我们在城市上空低低地飞行，然后慢慢爬高。这时飞机突然调转头来，飞回了机场。

lines.en: While we were waiting to land, a flight attendant told us to keep calm and to get off the plane quietly as soon as it had touched down.
lines.zh: 在我们等待降落时，一位空中乘务员告诉我们要保持镇静，待飞机一着陆，就马上不声不响地离开飞机。

lines.en: Everybody on board was worried and we were curious to find out what had happened.
lines.zh: 飞机上的人都很着急，大家都急于想知道究竟出了什么事。

lines.en: Later we learnt that there was a very important person on board.
lines.zh: 后来我们才得知，飞机上坐了一位非常重要的人物。

lines.en: The police had been told that a bomb had been planted on the plane.
lines.zh: 有人报告警察，说飞机上安放了一枚炸弹。

lines.en: After we had landed, the plane was searched thoroughly .
lines.zh: 我们降落之后，飞机被彻底搜查了一遍。

lines.en: Fortunately, nothing was found and five hours later we were able to take off again.
lines.zh: 幸运的是，什么也没有找到。5个小时后，我们又起飞了。

questions.q: Why did the plane turn back?
questions.a: Because the police had been told that a bomb had been planted on the plane, so it had to fly back and be searched thoroughly.
questions.aZh: 因为警方接到举报，说飞机上被安放了一枚炸弹，飞机必须返航接受彻底搜查。
questions.hint: 见 The police had been told that a bomb had been planted on the plane。

questions.q: What did the flight attendant tell the passengers to do while they were waiting to land?
questions.zh: 等待降落时，空中乘务员让乘客做什么？
questions.a: She told them to keep calm and to get off the plane quietly as soon as it had touched down.
questions.aZh: 她让大家保持镇静，等飞机一着陆就悄悄下机。
questions.hint: 见 While we were waiting to land…；as soon as 后用过去完成时。

questions.q: How does the writer show the difference between 'used to do' and 'be used to doing'?
questions.zh: 作者如何区分 used to do 与 be used to doing？
questions.a: 'used to travel / live / fly' (and 'a flight attendant would take charge of me') describe past habits; 'I am used to travelling by air' means being accustomed to flying now.
questions.aZh: 前三处 used to + 动词原形表示过去经常发生的事；am used to travelling 表示现在习惯于乘飞机。
questions.hint: 对比前三句与 am used to travelling；to 后接原形还是 -ing 是分水岭。

questions.q: Why is 'only on one occasion have I ever felt frightened' inverted?
questions.zh: 为什么这句话要倒装？正常语序是什么？
questions.a: Because 'only + adverbial' at the beginning requires partial inversion. Normal order: I have ever felt frightened only on one occasion.
questions.aZh: only 加状语置于句首时须部分倒装，助动词 have 提到主语 I 之前。

questions.q: Do you think the VIP and the bomb report were connected? How might the five-hour search change a passenger's attitude?
questions.zh: 你认为这位要人与炸弹举报有关吗？五小时的搜查会怎样改变乘客对飞行的态度？
questions.a: The two facts are placed side by side, which suggests the bomb threat was aimed at the VIP; even a traveller used to flying may feel frightened after a five-hour search, though the closing line shows his confidence returned.
questions.aZh: 作者把两件事紧邻叙述，暗示二者相关；五个小时的搜查足以让习惯了飞行的人再次害怕，而结尾又显示作者重拾信心。
questions.hint: 结合要人与炸弹举报的先后顺序与结尾 Fortunately 的语气。

translation:
我在幼年的时候，曾多次乘飞机旅行。
我的父母曾经住在南美洲，所以假期里我常从欧洲乘飞机到他们那里。
我总是由一位空中乘务员照管，从未遇到过不愉快的经历。
我习惯了乘飞机旅行，只是有一次把我吓坏了。
起飞之后，我们在城市上空低低地飞行，然后慢慢爬高。
这时飞机突然调转头来，飞回了机场。
在我们等待降落时，一位空中乘务员告诉我们要保持镇静，待飞机一着陆，就马上不声不响地离开飞机。
飞机上的人都很着急，大家都急于想知道究竟出了什么事。
后来我们才得知，飞机上坐了一位非常重要的人物。
有人报告警察，说飞机上安放了一枚炸弹。
我们降落之后，飞机被彻底搜查了一遍。
幸运的是，什么也没有找到。
5个小时后，我们又起飞了。
title: By air
subtitle: 乘飞机

lead.question: 飞机刚起飞却突然掉头飞回机场，机组到底收到了什么消息？机上究竟藏着什么？
lead.warmup: 你有过飞机起飞后被通知返航的经历吗？设想机舱广播只说“请保持镇静，着陆后安静下机”却不作解释，你会不会心跳加速？本课作者是位“飞行老手”：小时候常往返欧洲与南美洲，由乘务员照管，从未遇到不愉快。可这位老手也有过一次被吓坏的经历。
goals: 听懂并记录飞机返航的直接原因、机上知情顺序与搜查结果
分清 used to do、would do 与 be used to doing 三种“过去/习惯”表达
掌握 only + 状语置于句首的部分倒装结构，并能还原为正常语序
活用 take charge of、on board、gain height、touch down、take off 等核心短语
lead.summary: 作者回忆：幼时常乘飞机往返欧洲与南美洲，每次由空中乘务员照管，从未有过不快，因而习惯了飞行。唯有一次起飞后在城市上空爬高时，飞机突然掉头返航；后来得知机上有位要人，警方接到举报说飞机上被安放了炸弹，降落后被彻底搜查，幸而无恙，五小时后再次起飞。
lead.tips: 别把 used to do（过去常常，接原形）与 be used to doing（习惯于，接动名词）混为一谈；only + 状语置句首时助动词必须提到主语之前。

exercises.q: 用 used to / would / be used to 的正确形式填空：When I was a boy, I ____ travel by air a great deal. My parents ____ live in South America and a flight attendant ____ take charge of me. Now I ____ travelling by air.
exercises.a: used to; used to; would; am used to
exercises.note: used to 接原形；be used to 接 -ing。

exercises.q: 冠词填空：____ flight attendant would take charge of me；there was ____ very important person on board；____ police had been told that ____ bomb had been planted on ____ plane.
exercises.note: 首次提及用 a/an，特指用 the。

exercises.q: 用 only on one occasion 开头改写句子：I have never felt frightened on any other occasion.
exercises.a: Only on one occasion have I ever felt frightened.

exercises.q: 用 take 短语动词的适当形式填空（take off / take after / take up / take over）：① The plane will ____ in half an hour. ② Jane ____ her mother. ③ This work won't ____ too much time. ④ The new manager will ____ next week.
exercises.a: take off; takes after; take up; take over

exercises.q: 用所给词的适当形式填空（parent / curious / plant / search / frighten）：My ____ used to live in South America. Everybody was worried and ____ to find out what had happened. A bomb had been ____ on the plane. The plane was ____ thoroughly. I have never felt ____ except on one occasion.
用 gain 的宾语补全搭配：① 飞机爬高 gain ____ ② 汽车加速 gain ____ ③ 体重增加 gain ____ ④ 获得自信 gain ____
汉译英：① 我小时候总由一位空中乘务员照管。② 起飞后我们在城市上空低低地飞行，然后慢慢爬高。
exercises.a: ① A flight attendant would take charge of me when I was a boy. ② After taking off, we flew low over the city and slowly gained height.
exercises.note: after + 动名词作时间状语。

quiz.q: “我习惯了乘飞机旅行”（现在仍然如此）的正确英文是？
options: I used to travel by air.
I am used to travelling by air.
I used to travelling by air.
I am used to travel by air.
touch down
take off
gain height
turn round

quiz.q: 课文中“只是有一次把我吓坏了”的原句是？
options: Only on one occasion have I ever felt frightened.
Only on one occasion I have ever felt frightened.
Only on one occasion did I ever felt frightened.
Only on one occasion I ever have felt frightened.
quiz.note: 助动词 have 须提到主语之前。

quiz.q: 课文中 take charge of 的意思最接近哪一项？
options: to take care of and be responsible for
to take something off
to charge a battery
to take a photograph

quiz.q: “有人报告警察说飞机上安放了一枚炸弹”的正确英文是？
options: The police had been told that a bomb had been planted on the plane.
The police had been told that a bomb had been planted in the plane.
The police had told that a bomb had planted on the plane.
The police had been told that a bomb had been planting on the plane.
quiz.note: 被动语态 + 过去完成时，用 on。

quiz.q: “我在幼年的时候曾多次乘飞机旅行”的正确英文是？
options: I used to travel by air a great deal when I was a boy.
I was used to travel by air a great deal when I was a boy.
I used to travelling by air a great deal when I was a boy.
I am used to travel by air a great deal when I was a boy.
